summary: Close deterministic decision replay and derive checks from local metadata

delivery.outcome: Reject unsupported decision rules and caller-supplied replay verdicts; derive required checks from hub/adopter metadata without invented observed PASS, preserve the advisory/publication boundary and publish immutable standard 0.20.70.
nonGoals: Change protected Validator App approval or controller effects
Implement arbitrary Policy DSL rule engines

architecture.decision: Use an exact supported rule set for deterministic replay, validate required check names, deny contradictory observations, and load default required check names from the local hub/adopter metadata. Preserve supported aliases and report codes. Missing observations do not become a synthetic PASS; denied evaluation remains denied.
interfaceChanges: Tighten existing advisory decision replay and default derivation inputs without adding publication authority.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Isolated unsupported-rule acceptance and adopter metadata path failures reproduce original defects. Supported aliases, explicit observations, missing/contradictory inputs and hub/adopter derivation cases behave deterministically.
Existing validator integration, parity, native gate and required exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev checks pass.
Independent protected merge and final immutable standard v0.20.70 publication are verified.
